newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BOE's George says markets over-reacted.
newsitem.headline: BOE's George says markets over-reacted.

text.p: Bank of England governor Eddie George said on Monday he believed markets over-reacted last week to comments by Federal Reserve Board chairman Alan Greenspan.

Asked whether Friday's sell-off in stock and bond markets around the world was an over-reaction to Thursday's comments by Greenspan, George said: "I think they did initially, but they soon sorted themselves out."

Greenspan sent world financial markets tumbling when he said the central bank needed to be wary when "irrational exuberance" infected stock and other asset markets because that could damage the economy.
George was speaking to reporters as he arrived at the Bank for International Settlements building for the monthly meeting of the G10 central bank governors.
Markets also decided that Friday's falls were overdone, with European stock markets rallying sharply in early trade following a surge of buying in Asia.
